entities.name: C-type natriuretic peptide
observations: CNP reduced cardiac norepinephrine release and stimulation-evoked tachycardia in isolated rat preparations; NPR-B antagonist prevented the norepinephrine-release effect.

entities.name: NPR-B (NPR2)
observations: Neuron-specific dominant-negative NPR-B in transgenic rats was associated with higher blood pressure and heart rate and HR-variability evidence of sympathoexcitation; NPR-B localized to tyrosine-hydroxylase-positive stellate neurons.

entities.name: Cardiac sympathetic neurotransmission
observations: In rat isolated atria and in vitro stellate-ganglion stimulation, CNP reduced norepinephrine release and tachycardia; response to exogenous norepinephrine remained intact, supporting a presynaptic action.

entities.name: PMID:27496871
observations: C-type natriuretic peptide and natriuretic peptide receptor B signalling inhibits cardiac sympathetic neurotransmission and autonomic function.
